title: convert `cypress/helpers/util.js` to ts
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

- add types for parameter and returned value and variables
- change the deprecated `unescape` into `decodeURIComponent`
- change the deprecated `btoa` into `Buffer.from`
- create `CypressConfig` and `CypressMermaidConfig` and `CodeObject` types
- add default value for some parameter
- fix wrong config paramater in some cypress spec  
  - flowchart
  - mindmap
- allow import ts in ts files

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Describe the way your implementation works or what design decisions you made if applicable.

author: Yokozuna59

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body:
I'm not sure about `validation`, I haven't see any diagram uses it so I setted it to `any`.

I saw one that used it as `boolean` but it doesn't seem right:

https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/d9db2edf5a07e19c3f5a41db0e375ca844a2754e/cypress/integration/other/external-diagrams.spec.js#L7

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Validation should have the type we can pass into `cy.should`.

https://docs.cypress.io/api/commands/should


eg: `'have.property', 'rendered', true`. 

Maybe it should be an `unknown[]`, which we can pass in like `cy.get('svg').should(...validation);`.

I'm not 100% sure here.

comments.author: Yokozuna59
sidharthv96
comments.body: That seems like a great idea.

comments.body: It would need more work, so it would be off the PR topic. Let's file an issue, discuss it there, and implement it when we have time.

comments.body:
created one here #4614. Let's leave it any for now, when applying those changes we'll, update it.

I'll resolve this conversation.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
We should use the commit hash or some env variable that Github actions exposes. 
As our E2E tests run in different machines, the batchID will be different for each shard.

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body:
I wasn't really sure what `batchId` so left it as it is.

I think this looks good:

```suggestion
const batchId: string = 'mermaid-batch' + execSync('git rev-parse HEAD').toString().trim();
```

---

To import `execSync`, you could to the following:
```ts
import { execSync } from 'child_process';
```

---

Sorry but didn't bring my laptop with me so you can update the branch as you wish :)
